answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to earn voting weight, creating a financial barrier to identity duplication. Like a walnut shell protecting its core, staking locks value to prevent malicious flooding. An attacker must possess significant timber, or liquid resources, to scale influence. If an actor attempts to sybil the network, they face slashing, rendering the cost of attack higher than the yarrow of yield earned from honest participation.
